story.title: Let customers download receipts as PDF

question.text: Where should the download be offered: on the receipt page only, or also as a bulk download from the order history?
question.recommendation: Receipt page only for now; bulk download needs a background job and is better as its own story.
question.answer: Receipt page only for now; bulk download needs a background job and is better as its own story. Also add the button to the order confirmation email link target.
